title: Advocate
description:
Company: Koolhomes

Location: Camp, Pune

Experience Required: Minimum 2 Years in Land \& Property Litigation

Employment Type: Full\-Time

​About Us:

Koolhomes is a leading real estate and construction company based in Pune. We are seeking a dynamic, detail\-oriented Advocate with strong local expertise to join our in\-house legal team at our office in Camp, Pune.

​Key Responsibilities:

​Handle all types of land and property litigation, including suit for injunction, declaration, partition, land acquisition, revenue matters, and RERA disputes.

​Draft legal notices, replies, plaints, written statements, affidavits, and legal applications in both English and Marathi.

​Conduct title search, due diligence, and legal vetting for land acquisitions.

​Represent and coordinate on behalf of the company in District Courts, High Court, Revenue Courts (Tehsildar/Collector/SDO), and RERA tribunals.

​Liaise effectively with external senior counsels, land revenue officials, and government bodies.

​Key Qualifications \& Requirements:

​Education: LL.B. or LL.M. from a recognized university.

​Registration: Enrolled with the Bar Council of Maharashtra \& Goa.

​Experience: 2\+ years of post\-qualification experience in land litigation and real estate laws.

​Language Proficiency: Full fluency in Marathi (spoken, written, and reading legal terminology) is mandatory. Candidate must be fluent in Marathi typing and legal drafting.

​Land Record Expertise: Proficient in reading, interpreting, and analyzing official Marathi land documents (7/12 extracts, Ferfar/Mutation entries, City Survey maps, Akhiv Patrika).

​Strong knowledge of the Maharashtra Land Revenue Code (MLRC), Transfer of Property Act, RERA, and local property laws.

​Remuneration: As per industry standards (Commensurate with experience)

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Analyst Risk & Compliance
description:
**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

"This position will be based in Eaton’s Global Supply Chain Center of Excellence (GSC CoE) in Pune and will contribute to the enhancement of productivity and efficiency of GSC CoE and SCM function.


The person in this position would be supporting Supplier Tooling, Supplier Performance \& Supply Chain Risk Management process.
  

These processes primarily drive
  

1\. Proactive and reactive supply risk detection \& Mitigation to ensure continuity of supply to Eaton plants.
  

2\. Measure, Analyze \& Report supplier's performance (KPIs) on a monthly basis.
  

3\.Centrally monitor Eaton owned tools to optimize usage and ensure timely maintenance."


"Functional Skills\-
  

\> Extract, Compile \& analyze relevant operational data from ERPs and various internal systems.
  

\> Solicit, maintain and track data for Eaton owned tooling \& work with operations for optimization and timely replacement/refurbishments.
  

\> Analyze and report various supply chain risk, supplier performance and tooling reports to SCM org.
  

\> Monitor Business critical Suppliers \& various risk events occurring globally using a 3rd Party tool.
  

\> Monitor \& Report supplier risk leveraging multidimensional risk model.
  

\> Sense impact of various Risk events on SC operations \& support Commodity Managers for the mitigation.
  

\> Co\-ordinate with various functional stakeholders to ensure consistent process execution with expected output.
  

\> Support various strategic SCM initiatives.
  

\> Leverage Digital skills to automate transactional tasks, build interactive \& insightful dashboards.
  

\> Drive continual process improvement
  

Technical Competencies \-
  

\> Data Analytics \& Project management skills
  

\> Well versed with MS office tools, mainly MS Excel, PowerPoint \& Access
  

\> Proficiency in Python, Power BI, Power Apps \& SharePoint sites.
  

\> Understanding of financial Risk evaluation using 3rd party tools like D\&B \& Rapid Ratings. "

Any Graduate

title: Legal & Compliance Officer - Company Secretary
description:
**An Italian Manufacturing Company, SIAD,** has its wholly owned subsidiary in India. It is one of **Europe's leading industrial groups** with a strong presence in Industrial Gases, Engineering, Healthcare, LPG, and Natural Gas.

Established in India in 2026, the company is developing its Engineering Centre and a state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility in Merkel, Pune, to support the Group's growing operations and its sister company, ESA Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.

The registered office \& working location will be in MIDC Bhosari Pune.

**Seniority:** The position reports directly to the Board, so candidates should currently be in middle management

**Legal \& Compliance Responsibilities (More Focused Area)**

* Advise the management and Board on legal, regulatory and corporate governance matters.
* Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, NDAs, vendor agreements, employment contracts, service agreements, loan documentation and other legal documents.
* Coordinate with external legal counsels and regulatory authorities on legal matters.
* Monitor compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and corporate governance requirements.
* Represent the Company before courts, quasi\-judicial authorities and government agencies whenever required.
* Develop and implement legal and compliance policies across the organization.
* Report significant legal and compliance matters to the Board.
* Maintain legal documentation and ensure effective contract management.
* Support legal and compliance activities for the Group's sister company, **ESA Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.**, as required.

**Company Secretarial Responsibilities**

* Manage all Company Secretarial functions in compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and Secretarial Standards.
* Organize and conduct Board Meetings, Committee Meetings and Shareholders' Meetings, including notices, agendas, minutes and statutory records.
* Ensure timely filing of statutory returns, annual reports, financial statements and other MCA compliances.
* Handle FEMA, RBI and MCA compliances relating to inward capital, ECBs, KYC and other regulatory approvals.
* Manage matters relating to issue of capital, changes in Board composition and other corporate actions.
* Maintain all statutory registers, records and corporate documentation.
* Act as the Company's Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), wherever applicable.
* Support relocation of the Registered Office and ensure all related statutory compliances.
* Liaise with MCA, RBI and other regulatory authorities for approvals and statutory matters.

**Experience \& Key Functional Competencies**

* 7\-9 years of experience as a Company Secretary, preferably in a manufacturing organization.
* Minimum 5 years of post\-qualification legal experience.
* The focus will be on strong legal experience
* Strong knowledge of Companies Act, FEMA, RBI regulations, MCA compliances, and corporate governance.
* Experience in handling Board Meetings, Shareholder Meetings, statutory filings, capital infusion, ECBs and regulatory approvals.
* Hands\-on experience in drafting and reviewing commercial contracts and legal documentation.
* Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Benefits**:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Pay: ₹2,000,000\.00 \- ₹2,400,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have Strong knowledge of the Companies Act, FEMA, RBI regulations, MCA compliances and corporate governance?
* The role requires 7\- 10 years of strong legal domain experience. Have you worked on legal and compliance matters related to setting up or expanding a manufacturing facility, industrial projects, including regulatory approvals, land, construction, or equipment procurement?
* Strong communication skills, post\-qualification legal experience and stakeholder management skills. How will you rate yourself on the scale of 1\-5?
* We need someone to start at the earliest (10\-20 days). How soon can you join us? (Immediate joiners will be preferred)
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?

Work Location: In person

title: Company Secretary and Legal Operations
description:
Company Secretary and Legal Operations
\- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \-


Job Description


**Job Title: Company Secretary \& Legal Operations**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly competent, skilled, and motivated Company Secretary and Legal


Counsel to join our dynamic legal team, supporting the AIM region of Michelin Group. The


ideal candidate will have 8–12 years of experience with strong expertise in company


secretarial and corporate governance matters, along with significant exposure to legal


operations and matters. The role will primarily be responsible for ensuring robust corporate


governance and end\-to\-end secretarial compliance for Michelin India, while also supporting


group entities across the AIM region on governance and secretarial matters. In addition, the


candidate will support business teams on other day\-to\-day legal matters on a need basis, and


proactively manage legal and regulatory compliance tools and operations.


**Key Responsibilities:**

**Company Secretarial and Governance**

* Manage end\-to\-end company secretarial compliances for Michelin India under the


Companies Act, 2013, including maintenance of statutory registers, filings, and


corporate records.


* Lead Board, Shareholders and Committee governance processes including preparation


of agendas, board notes, minutes, resolutions, and ensuring timely coordination with


stakeholders and implementation of decisions.


* Ensure compliance with corporate governance frameworks, internal policies, and


global guidelines, including Code of Ethics and delegation frameworks.


* Coordinate with external advisors, auditors, and regulators for corporate secretarial


matters, including ROC filings and regulatory submissions, like POSH, etc.


* Support group entities in the AIM region on corporate governance, board processes,


and secretarial compliance requirements, as required.


* Drive standardization and improvement of governance documentation, processes, and


templates in alignment with global practices.


**Legal Operations and Compliance Management**


* Manage legal and compliance obligations through compliance management tools,


ensuring tracking, monitoring, and timely closure of all actions.


* Maintain contract lifecycle and legal documentation through document management


systems ensuring version control and accessibility.


* Support implementation of legal tech initiatives and generation of dashboards/reports


for legal operations.


**Legal support and advisory (on a need basis)**

* Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts.


* Provide clear, practical, and business\-oriented legal advice to stakeholders on


contractual rights, obligations, liabilities, and risk mitigation strategies.


* Support pre\-litigation and dispute management activities, including drafting legal


notices, replies, and coordinating with external counsel.


* Manage and monitor litigation matters, including tracking case progress, coordinating


with external counsel, and supporting strategy and documentation for court and


arbitration proceedings.


* Advise stakeholders on legal risks and mitigation strategies across business operations,


contracts, and transactions to minimize exposure.


* Conduct legal research and provide advisory support on corporate, commercial,


employment, and regulatory matters.


* Stay updated on legal developments and proactively advise business teams.


**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in legal tech tools including CLM and compliance management systems.
* Experience with document management systems and governance tools.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.

Personal Attributes and Behavioral Competencies


* Strong business orientation and stakeholder management skills.
* High integrity and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

**Qualifications**


* Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI membership mandatory).
* A bachelor’s degree in law from a reputed law school or university. A master’s degree


in law is preferred but not mandatory.


* Admission to the bar in at least one jurisdiction in India.


* 8\-12 years of relevant experience in legal and secretarial roles.
* Demonstrated experience in a similar role within a corporate legal department, with a


strong understanding of corporate governance/secretarial and legal affairs.


* Certifications in corporate/business law, secretarial compliance, or related fields are


highly desirable.
